"""Load a CGMES 2.4.15 model (EQ + SSH + TP + SV) into pandapower."""
import logging from pathlib import Path
import pandapower as pp from pandapower.converter.cim import from_cim as cim2pp logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
CIM_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "_ignore_situation_files"
# The converter detects each profile from the md:Model.profile header, # so the order of the files does not matter. file_list = [ str(CIM_DIR / "EC-2.4.xml"), # EQ - EquipmentCore str(CIM_DIR / "SSH.xml"), # SSH - SteadyStateHypothesis str(CIM_DIR / "TP.xml"), # TP - Topology str(CIM_DIR / "SV.xml"), # SV - StateVariables ]
net = cim2pp.from_cim( file_list=file_list, cgmes_version="2.4.15", use_sv_data_for_assets=True, # take operating points from the SV profile create_measurements="SV", # build measurements from SV power flows run_powerflow=False, ignore_errors=True, )
print(net)
# Solve the imported network pp.runpp(net) print(net.res_bus.describe())
